cards.card_text: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sends for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites and the guards.
cards.verse_text: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, and the guards, and had them brought into the house of the LORD.

cards.card_text: Then Jehoiada takes the commanders, the Carites, the guards and all the people of the land with him, and they bring the king down to the royal palace by the Gate of the Guards.
cards.verse_text: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards, and all the people of the land, and they brought the king down from the house of the LORD and entered the royal palace by way of the Gate of the Guards.
